facts.fact: Health Minister Mustapha Ferjani said at the signing of the National Health Pact on 1 October 2026 that the shared medical record, with the national health identifier and telemedicine, was being generalised nationwide after successful pilot phases; no facility count is given.

The National Health Pact signed on 1 October 2026 by the health and communication-technologies ministers is described by the health minister as an agreement between the Ministry of Health and its partners, and he presents the shared medical record as the ministry's programme being generalised nationally.
